actions.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU from /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode, expose VNC on :1 (port 5901), provide nginx web access on port 80, and leave the VM running at the Windows 3.11 desktop with programmatic keyboard input enabled.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
Evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
Evidence that keyboard input can be injected programmatically beyond VNC interaction
required_behaviors: QEMU must run in the background after startup
Base disk image must remain immutable via snapshot mode
External/programmatic keyboard control must be configured
Web interface must be reachable via nginx on port 80
known_invalid_patterns: Prompt echo or configuration text without a running VM
Evidence that does not show the VM desktop or input capability
verification_plan: Inspect available runtime tools and receipts
Start QEMU with the required display, snapshot, and input configuration
Verify VNC is listening on 5901 and nginx on 80
Connect/inspect the VM until the Windows 3.11 desktop is visible
Verify programmatic keyboard injection path works
Keep the VM running in the background and collect receipts for each step
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing QEMU launched with snapshot mode and VNC :1/5901
Receipt showing nginx listening on port 80
Receipt showing the Windows 3.11 desktop reached in the VM
Receipt showing programmatic keyboard input capability configured or exercised
